chapter one

How did we get here?

Dear Saru,

We started as two people who became friends in 6th standard, survived school together, and somehow ended up here in 2nd year degree. Technically, that's years of friendship. Emotionally, that's approximately 47 lifetimes, 800 arguments, 3,000 inside jokes and one suspicious amount of gossip.

Our actual bonding really began around 9th standard, and from there you became permanently attached to my life. Like a bone. A very stubborn, very supportive bone. 😭

"The boring school days were never actually boring when I had you beside me. Even the drama became entertainment because we had each other to gossip about it with."

From little fights and arguments to playtime, laughing until we couldn't breathe, those legendary special maths classes after 3:30, and all the random moments that nobody else would understand... I wouldn't trade those memories for anything.

We've had ups and downs. People tried to create distance between us with their opinions and their stories, but somehow we kept choosing our friendship. And I'm really, really glad we did.

official saru appreciation page

Things I need you to know

♡ My healer: You have a way of making difficult days feel a little less heavy.
♡ My supporter: You have had my back more times than I can count.
♡ My emergency response team: Somehow you always manage to show up when I need you.
♡ My advice department: Your advice has saved me from several questionable decisions. Probably.
♡ My motivation: You push me, encourage me and remind me that I can do things even when I doubt myself.
♡ My permanent person: We can go days without talking and still understand each other. That's something I treasure.
from my heart, unfortunately

A little letter for you

Saru, I don't think I'll ever be able to properly explain how grateful I am that Allah put you in my life. You have been there through versions of me that I don't even recognize anymore, and somehow you've stayed.

I know I may not always match the way you show love or express how much you care. Sometimes I probably don't say enough, and sometimes I probably act like everything is normal when I'm actually very grateful for you. But please know this: you mean an immense amount to me.

Thank you for every time you listened, every time you defended me, every time you came running to my rescue, every piece of advice, every laugh, every argument we eventually survived, and every ordinary day that became a memory simply because you were there.

We've grown from two schoolgirls who had no idea what adulthood was going to look like into two people who can understand each other without needing constant explanations. And honestly, I hope that never changes.

In sha Allah, we keep growing together. Through college, careers, random life problems, ridiculous stories and everything in between. And one day we'll look back at all this and wonder how we managed to be this chaotic for this long. 😭

No matter where life takes us, I want you to know that you will always have a place in my life and in my heart. I may not have the perfect way of showing it, but I will always try to make you feel as special as you truly are to me.

Happy birthday, Saru. May Allah bless you with happiness, peace, success, good health, beautiful opportunities and people who love you sincerely. You deserve so much goodness. 🤍

Always your bone,
♡ Me
